fullDescription: Xan CRM is a high-end, finance-oriented design system characterized by a sophisticated dark-mode aesthetic with light-mode compatibility. It features a professional 'glass-panel' look using Outfit for UI copy and JetBrains Mono for data-heavy elements. The style is ideal for fintech, SaaS dashboards, and administrative platforms. Key visual markers include subtle mouse-tracking spotlight effects, vibrant color-coded status badges with pulse animations, and high-contrast accent glows. The layout utilizes a structured sidebar and a comprehensive data table with integrated bulk actions.

structured.summary: A professional CRM Invoice List interface featuring a dark/light mode toggle, glassmorphic paneling, and high-precision typography. The design emphasizes data clarity through monospaced numerals and interactive elements like spotlight-hover cards and animated status indicators.

style.description: The style guide centers on a tiered background system (Base #0D0D0D, Panel #161616, Elevated #1C1C1C) and a primary 'Xan Blue' accent (#3B82F6). Typography pairs the geometric 'Outfit' font for readability with 'JetBrains Mono' for financial data. Animations use a signature 'ease-smooth' cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for transitions, including a custom mouse-following spotlight radial gradient on cards.
style.prompt: Create a design using the Xan CRM style guide. Typography: Use 'Outfit' (weights 400-900) for all UI labels and headers; use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data and IDs. Color Palette (Dark Mode): Base Background #0D0D0D, Panel Background #161616, Input Background #1C1C1C, Primary Blue #3B82F6, Emerald #34D399, Amber #FBBF24, Rose #FB7185. Spacing: 8px grid system with 32px (p-8) main container padding. Borders: 1px solid #222222 for panels. Interactivity: Apply a spotlight effect using a radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%) that follows the cursor on hover. Include 'dot-pulse' animations on status indicators (2s infinite ease-in-out opacity pulse).

layout_and_structure.description: A classic dashboard layout consisting of a fixed 260px sidebar for primary navigation, a 64px tall header with search and theme toggles, and a scrollable main content area structured in a modular grid.

prompts.prompt: Width 260px, background #161616 with a 1px right border #222222. Logo area 64px tall. Nav links: 14px font size, 12px vertical padding, 12px border-radius. Active state: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), text color #F1F5F9, icon color #3B82F6. Include sub-section headers in 10px JetBrains Mono, uppercase with 0.2em letter spacing.

Height 64px, sticky top. Contains page title (18px, extrabold), sub-navigation links (11px, bold, uppercase), a search input (height 36px, width 224px, bg #1C1C1C), a theme toggle, and a primary CTA button. CTA Button: bg #3B82F6, text white, 14px bold, box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4).

Five-column grid layout. Each card 1px solid #222222, bg #161616. Feature a 44px rounded-xl icon container with 10% opacity accent background. Metrics: 10px mono label, 24px mono value. The fifth card should be a high-contrast gradient card: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6, #2563EB).

Main panel bg #161616, border-radius 16px. Table header: bg rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02), text 10px mono bold, uppercase, tracking 0.15em. Row height 56px. Hover state: bg rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02). Status badges: inline-flex, pill-shaped, 10px bold, 10% bg opacity of the status color, featuring a 6px pulse dot.

Floating or fixed-width bar appearing above the table. Background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1), border: 1px solid #3B82F6, padding: 12px 20px, border-radius: 12px. Displays count of selected items and horizontal list of action buttons (text 11px bold).

special_ui_components.description: Interactive card that highlights based on mouse position.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement using a CSS variable system where --mouse-x and --mouse-y are updated via JS on mousemove. Background is a fixed panel color with a ::before pseudo-element containing a radial gradient from rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) to transparent. Ensure transition-property 'opacity' is used to fade the spotlight in on hover.

Height 24px, padding 0 10px. Font size 10px, weight 700. Example 'Paid' status: color #34D399, background rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1). Include a 6px circle child element with background #34D399 and an animation 'pulse-dot' that scales and fades the box-shadow.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the JetBrains Mono font specifically for prices, IDs, and dates to ensure a technical look. MUST use the specific cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all hover and entrance animations. DO NOT use standard browser checkboxes; use custom-styled #333333 squares with #3B82F6 checkmarks. DO NOT use generic gray for borders; use #222222 specifically for dark mode and #E2E8F0 for light mode.
